name: The Canyon Suites at The Phoenician
positioning: The Canyon Suites at The Phoenician, a Luxury Collection Resort: Southwest-styled rooms, suites and villas at the base of Camelback Mountain in Scottsdale
best_for: Travelers who want a desert base with easy access to Camelback Mountain trails
Groups wanting a private villa with a gourmet kitchen

facts.text: The resort sits at the base of Camelback Mountain in Scottsdale, Arizona, with easy access to hiking, biking and horseback riding trails.
Rooms have custom decor with Southwest-inspired finishes and a private patio with views of the pool, Camelback Mountain or the Sonoran Valley.
Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto a private patio or terrace with a daybed.
Bedding includes Frette 400-count Italian linens and duvets.
The Presidential Suite has a king bed and is a one-bedroom suite that can be converted into a two-bedroom suite.
The villas have gas fireplaces in the living rooms, floor-to-ceiling stacking glass doors and outdoor patio fire tables with seating.
The villas have gourmet kitchens with premium appliances, stocked cookware and an espresso machine.
Canyon Suites guests get complimentary breakfast daily in the Canyon Lounge, which serves wine, beer and cocktails for purchase in the evening with Camelback Mountain views.
Additional amenities include multiple pools, a spa and fitness center, golf, and fine and casual dining.
The Phoenician Golf Club has an 18-hole course for all skill levels with mountain and city views.
Activities include specialty dinners, kids' crafts and pool games, mixology classes, bike tours to Old Town Scottsdale and hikes to Camelback Mountain.
The hotel is pet-friendly and offers a Canyon Canine Room Service Menu for dogs.

highlights.text: The Villas at Canyon Suites are free-standing, single-level villas with valley and golf views.
Villa guests have private access to an exclusive pool and spa with cabanas, fire-pit seating and full dining service.
Accommodations have outdoor patios or terraces with daybeds, and private cabanas are available at the infinity pool.
Decor and artwork are sourced directly from local creatives and artisans in Scottsdale.
Villa guests get a private golf cart for getting around the resort grounds.

considerations.text: A daily resort fee is charged to each room for a range of amenities.
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is about 9 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the desert location may be very warm during the summer months.
